cohort: 3254 full-term, singleton newborns born at > 37 gestational weeks at a 3rd-level neonatal center in 2016.
finding: In healthy term newborns, ethnicity and gender differences did not affect weight loss, but newborns delivered vaginally had their maximal weight loss after 42 hours as opposed to 72 hours for the ones born by cesarean section.
mod_finding: Newborns delivered vaginally had their maximal weight loss after 42 hours as opposed to 72 hours for the ones born by cesarean section.
